Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — returns n clamped to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts with one decimal place (B, KB, MB, GB)
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL-safe slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing spaces with dashes, and stripping non-alphanumeric characters

All follow the project conventions and are exported from their respective modules.
